# Elias Purdy MacKinnon

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P33](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P17](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0017)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Elias Purdy MacKinnon is a comical-looking youth with a broad, chubby face. He has tiny blue eyes and prominent ears that flare outward like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Elias Purdy MacKinnon aspires to become a minister. However, he has noted that working as a carpenter would be a simpler pursuit than achieving his religious ambition.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Regent’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P20](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0020)_
